title: Final Differential Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the equation for dr/dtheta in terms of E0, L, G(r), r, and m.

title: Final Closest Approach Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express r_min in terms of E0, L, G(r_min), and m.

title: Energy Conservation Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the conservation of energy to relate kinetic and potential energy.

title: Angular Momentum Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the conservation of angular momentum in the derivation.

title: Correct Sign Usage
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the equations derived.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all terms in the equations have consistent units.

title: Clear Derivation Steps
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide clear and logical steps in their derivation process.

title: Limiting Cases Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or special scenarios relevant to the problem.
